findingResolution.resolution: CR-T9 at README.md:248 ends with the r3 replacement verbatim. A reserved-name collision refuses in both validate and validate_inventory. A live-name collision of a different (stableId, provenance) refuses in validate only, and validate_inventory, which receives reserved names and no live-name context, keeps that collision inventory-valid. The map's line-range sentence is unchanged. The r3 sentence that put a live-name refusal on both entry points is gone.

r3 had applied the required replacements and left this partly open because the added CR-T9 sentence mis-stated the inventory route. That sentence is now the r3 replacement. Only command-tree validation is conditional on commands. Component-name and manifest-alias admission stays mandatory for every role, with the existing reserved-name route in both entry points and the existing live-name route in validate only.
